rule: Mirror of eav.text.sentences: split after . ? ! and the Bengali danda (optionally followed by one closing quote or parenthesis) when whitespace follows. offsets partition text: first starts at 0, each later one at its first visible character, trailing whitespace stays with the earlier sentence, last ends at len(text). sentences = eav.text.sentences output (whitespace collapsed); for every sentence, ' '.join(text[start:end].split()) must equal it.
